title: Add vendor-neutral conservation and stability cases
scope: Add analytic/invariant momentum, energy accounting and timestep/mass-ratio fixtures independent of CUDA goldens.
acceptance: Deliberately wrong outputs fail each invariant.
Numerical limits derive from documented profiles, not current reference outputs.
evidence: PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s conformance/v1/tests -p 'test_*.py' (33); deliberate linear/angular momentum, inactive exchange, energy injection, split/combined state, sweep, hash, execution and provenance corruptions fail.

PASS: core-conservation-stability-v1 evaluates 18 pressure/contact and viscosity samples across 0.001/0.01/0.05 s and 1:1/1:2/1:4 endpoint mass ratios; valid CLI result passes and corrupted momentum result exits 1.

PASS: ctest --test-dir build-foundations -R 'parallel-mater-conformance-(case-registry|comparator-tests|command-inputs)' (3/3); installed corpus includes the hashed profile and tools/check_sdk_install.py passed all stages.
REVIEW: the profile/evaluator define the driver-neutral gate but do not qualify a driver; F2-10 must produce public-API results per advertising driver.
